problem_plain: Rio Tinto's Gudai-Darri iron ore mine needed a production management and monitoring layer to manage complex automated operations and convert real-time operational data into consistent production KPIs.
capability: Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and production management layer using AVEVA Production Management (Ampla) and AVEVA PI System historian, with fixed-plant circuit-based monitoring, equipment time-usage tracking, delay-event auto-coding, and laboratory equipment monitoring.
reusable: AVEVA Production Management (Ampla) combined with AVEVA PI System historian for fixed-plant circuit-based monitoring, equipment time-usage tracking, delay-event auto-coding and laboratory equipment monitoring in automated mining operations.
summary: Veridane delivered an MES and production management layer at Gudai-Darri, Rio Tinto's fully automated iron ore mine in the Pilbara, combining AVEVA Ampla with the PI System historian. The solution converts real-time operational data into consistent production KPIs, supporting availability and utilisation analysis, faster root-cause response, and safer, more efficient operations.
